description.value: Pajo's began in 1985 as the first floating restaurant in Steveston Harbour, founded by Pat Branch whose family ties to the local fishing fleet shaped its identity around wild Pacific seafood cooked in a signature tempura batter. The Steveston Wharf location sits directly on the waterfront in a historic fishing village that is a natural destination on Richmond's popular dyke cycling routes. Pajo's is 100% Vancouver Aquarium Ocean Wise certified and uses house-cut Kennebec potatoes grown locally in Delta, BC.
